global_ewaste_monitor.publisher: UNITAR / ITU / Global E-waste Statistics Partnership
global_ewaste_monitor.license: See publication terms — contact scycle@unitar.org for bulk data
global_ewaste_monitor.note: No bulk CSV download is publicly available. Data used in this project comes from published report annexes and the ITU DataHub. A curated dataset is embedded in data/synthetic_demo/.
global_ewaste_monitor.manual_instructions:
1. Visit https://ewastemonitor.info/monitors/ 
2. Download the PDF report and Annex 2 data tables.
3. For raw data, email scycle@unitar.org or use the ITU DataHub.
4. Place extracted CSV/Excel in data/raw/ewaste/global_ewaste_monitor/.

india_ewaste_cpcb.dataset_name: India Year-wise E-Waste Generated and Recycled (CPCB)
india_ewaste_cpcb.license: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP), Government of India
india_ewaste_cpcb.note: Requires free registration on data.gov.in to obtain an API key. Data covers national totals; state-level data has separate resource IDs.
india_ewaste_cpcb.manual_instructions:
1. Register at https://data.gov.in and obtain a free API key.
2. Use the API: https://api.data.gov.in/resource/<resource_id>?api-key=<YOUR_KEY>&format=csv
3. Resource ID for e-waste generation: check https://www.data.gov.in/resource/year-wise-details-volume-e-waste-generated-and-recycled-under-e-waste-management-rules
4. Place downloaded CSV in data/raw/ewaste/india_ewaste_cpcb/.

nasa_battery_aging.publisher: NASA Ames Research Center — Prognostics Center of Excellence
nasa_battery_aging.note: Data is in MATLAB .mat format. Community-converted CSV versions are available on Kaggle. Do NOT assume laboratory results generalize to all consumer devices.
nasa_battery_aging.manual_instructions:
Option A (official): 
  1. Visit https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/li-ion-battery-aging-datasets
  2. Download the battery data archive.
  3. Extract .mat files to data/raw/batteries/nasa_battery/.
  4. Run: python src/battery_analysis.py --convert-mat

Option B (CSV — Kaggle community version): 
  Search Kaggle for 'NASA Battery Dataset' and download the CSV version.
  Place CSVs in data/raw/batteries/nasa_battery/.

oecd_environmental.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
oecd_environmental.note: Use the OECD Data Explorer to select relevant environmental indicators and export CSV.
oecd_environmental.manual_instructions:
1. Visit https://data-explorer.oecd.org
2. Select the 'Environment' domain.
3. Filter by relevant indicators (e.g., municipal waste, hazardous waste).
4. Export the filtered dataset as CSV.
5. Place in data/raw/pollution/oecd_environmental/.

epa_environmental.note: Multiple sub-datasets available. Identify specific dataset before integrating. Do NOT automatically attribute measurements to e-waste processing.

epa_water_quality.note: Very large dataset. Use the Water Quality Portal query interface to filter by location, date, and analyte before downloading. Do NOT attribute water quality observations to e-waste without evidence.
epa_water_quality.manual_instructions:
1. Visit https://www.waterqualitydata.us/
2. Filter by state, date range, and relevant analytes (e.g., Lead, Cadmium, Mercury, Arsenic).
3. Download results as CSV.
4. Place in data/raw/water_quality/epa_water_quality/.
